scripts.setup: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run datasets
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
